title: Private Tour Downtown to the Hollywood Sign in a 1965 Mustang
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the vibrant streets of Los Angeles in a stunning 1965 Mustang Convertible. This private tour spans 3 to 4 hours, from Downtown LA to Hollywood. We will see several iconic Los Angeles landmarks along the way such as Dodger Stadium, City Hall, Walt Disney Concert Hall, Angels Flights, Crypto.com arena (formerly Staples Center) the Hollywood Blvd Walk of Fame, Grauman's Chinese Theatre, Dolby Theatre, El Capitan Theatre and the world famous Hollywood Sign. There will be 2 stops on the tour. Stop number 1 will be one hour at the historic Grand Central Market downtown for Lunch, and then Stop number 2 will be at the Hollywood Sign for photos. Join us and discover the rich culture and stories of LA while capturing unforgettable photos with the Mustang at every major site. Perfect for first-time visitors or those wanting a fresh perspective on the city, this tour promises a unique blend of comfort, style, and insider knowledge.
